title: Heuristic intake and prioritization playbook for compliance/security asks
creator: Sofia Chen
description:
Summary: Define a consistent, lightweight playbook that product managers and solutions engineers can use to intake, score, and route enterprise security and compliance requests (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, and vendor questionnaires). Goal is to reduce ad-hoc routing, speed vendor questionnaire turnaround, and create measurable SLAs for initial response and resolution.

Scope: non-bug requests originating from customers and prospects, compliance questionnaires, DPA/contract asks, audit evidence requests, SOC2/ISO certification inquiries, HIPAA readiness questions, and data residency/VPC requirements. Not in scope: incident response, critical security vulnerabilities (SEC- prefix), or infra outages.

Deliverables:
- A 1-page intake form template for sales/solutions/CS to submit requests (fields + rationale).
- A deterministic scoring rubric (risk x complexity) that computes an intake score and routing bucket (Quick Answer, Requires Security Review, Requires Eng Project).
- SLA definitions: initial acknowledgment (<= 2 business days), triage decision (<= 7 business days for non-critical), target turnaround for common items (vendor questionnaires 10 business days for Bronze/managed template; 20 days for bespoke).
- Routing rules and escalation paths: when to open a Security ticket (SEC-), when to create an Engineering project (ENG-), and when PM will handle via product policy changes.
- A short glossary for sales/CS to avoid repeated clarifying questions.
- Operational metrics: intake volume by type, time-to-triage, time-to-resolution, reopen rate, CS satisfaction score.

Core heuristic (scoring rubric):
- Customer sensitivity (3 = regulated PHI/financial data; 2 = user PII; 1 = low/no user data)
- Business impact (3 = deal-blocker / >$250k ARR impact; 2 = mid; 1 = low)
- Effort estimate (3 = requires infra/architecture change; 2 = requires config + small eng changes; 1 = doc/template or policy)
- Compliance scope (3 = SOC2/HIPAA/ISO certification artifacts; 2 = GDPR/DPA legal asks; 1 = vendor questionnaire simple)
Compute: intake_score = sum of above (3..12). Routing: 3-5 = Quick Answer (CS/PM); 6-8 = Security review + PM owner; 9-12 = Cross-functional eng + security project with executive visibility.

Routing details:
- Quick Answer: PM or CS provides templated evidence, no engineering changes. SLA: 10 business days.
- Security Review: Security owner performs gap analysis, may request artifacts from infra; PM owns comms. SLA: initial review 7 business days, decision to escalate within 10 days.
- Eng Project: create ENG- ticket, attach intake form and security checklist. Target timeline set in ENG- planning.

Trade-offs considered:
- Strict SLAs reduce back-and-forth but increase triage overhead: mitigate by automation (intake form with computed score) and templated responses.
- Centralized Security gating improves consistency but can become a bottleneck; solution: SLO-based routing and a split-tier 'fast lane' for <6 scores.
- We prioritize deal-blocker asks higher even if effort is moderate to prevent revenue loss.

Implementation plan:
1) Draft intake form & rubric (this ticket).
2) Pilot with Solutions Engineering and two EMEA enterprise accounts for 3 weeks.
3) Iterate templates and update CS playbooks.
4) Automate scoring in Zendesk / internal intake tracker.
5) Formalize SLAs and publish in internal Confluence + CS enablement session.

Metrics/KPIs:
- Mean time to triage decision (goal < 7 business days).
- Vendor questionnaire throughput (percentage completed within target window).
- Percent of intake autoscored and routed without manual edits (goal 70% after automation).
- CS satisfaction after resolution (NPS-style question).

Acceptance criteria:
- Intake template + rubric approved by Security and PM.
- Pilot completion with sample of >= 10 requests and metrics collected.
- Automation prototype that computes score and suggests routing is live in the intake tracker.

Notes on privacy/legal involvement: Any intake that scores a 3 on Customer sensitivity or queries data residency will automatically CC Legal and Privacy. Data transfer and DPA clauses require Legal sign-off.

Longer-term ideas (future tickets):
- Pre-approved artifact library for SOC2/ISO evidence to reduce repetitive work.
- A self-serve customer portal to request standard evidence (SaaS customers) with audit logs.
- SLA-backed premium offering for expedited questionnaire handling for Dedicated customers.

Related artifacts and links: see links field.
